column1: # The saves of the launcher's --every-value run (launcher/src/EveryValue.cs), for tools/ini_document_test.cpp:
# the game's writer (host/ini_document.hpp) must make the launcher's bytes from the same file and changes.
# Written by: chili_ini_document_test --make-fixture <the folder --every-value wrote into> <this folder>.
#   S <length> <hash> <second hash>                    start.ini, the file the launcher began with
#   T <save> <the save its file came from, 0 = start.ini> <changes> <length> <hash> <second hash>   what the launcher wrote
#   C <section> <key> <set|raw|unset> <value>          one change of the save, in the order made (\t \r \n \\ escaped)
#   K <file> <save>                                    a settings file the run kept: the file that save left
# The two [Disc] Path values of the run were replaced by neutral paths afterwards; the rows of those saves
# were then written from the game's writer.
